description:
Delete a saved speaker for good: their name, fingerprint, stored sample and any cloned voice are erased at once and cannot be restored.
Use: the person should no longer be recognised, or asked for their voice to be removed. A name inside one transcription: update_speaker.
Arguments: speakerId only: the id field from list_speakers, or the speakerId update_speaker returned with save. A speaker number such as 2 (from "Speaker 2") or a transcriptionId is wrong here; to unname someone in one transcription, use update_speaker with an empty name instead. Example: {speakerId: "0190f0e0-7c1a-7d3e-9b2a-5f4e3d2c1b0a"}.
Behaviour: free; the erasure is complete before the call returns, with no trash and no undo. Transcripts keep every line they spoke and their speaker numbers; lines that showed the saved name show "Speaker N" again. From then on new and running transcriptions no longer recognise them, and translations of their words read aloud use a stock voice instead of their clone. The id is never reused: saving the same person again (update_speaker with save) gives a new speakerId and needs their consent again to clone. A repeat call answers not_found and changes nothing. Gives rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past 600 calls a minute per API key.
Returns: speakerId, deleted true.
Errors: not_found for an unknown or already deleted id, or one of another account; forbidden for a read-only key.

speakerId.description: A saved speaker's id: id in list_speakers, or speakerId from update_speaker with save.

name: delete_speaker
title: Delete a saved speaker
